 At Chandigarh

sentences.text: Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Jagmohan Bansal

Present : Mr. Ashish Naik, Advocate
 for the petitioner.
 Ms. Priyanka Sadar, Aag, Haryana.

Learned State counsel submits that police after completing investigation has filed cancellation report on 20.11.2021 and it stands accepted by the Trial Court, thus, present petition seeking direction to the private respondent to conduct fair, proper and impartial investigation of FIR No.369 dated 24.08.2021 (Annexure P-1), under Sections 406, 498A, 323, 506 and 120B of IPC, registered at Police Station Sector-5, District Panchkula (Haryana), has rendered infructuous.
Dismissed as having been rendered infructuous.
